about: Kentucky park hours, after-dark rules and fees. DONE rows from KPC_Park_Hours_done.xlsx (Oct 25, official page per park) + round 7 facts for other parks (rows with a source link only). Any park with no hours or fee listed shows the default 'free and open' line (Brandon Oct 25). Confirm on the linked page. Oct 25: 'access' = visitor limits from eec.ky.gov (round 10, HQ wording for Green River).
default: Free and open: the official page lists no hours or entry fee.
feeNote: Kentucky State Parks charge no general entry fee; camping, lodging, golf, museums and tours can cost extra.
